headline: The Sayla Hotel / EKAR Architects
context: "Nimmana Haeminda" is a community in which a small guest house of "Baan Sayla" is located. The community used to combine distinct characters of local residents, namely, merchants, teachers, and a mix of creatives and artists through generations.
